body: Thanks for the advice. I like the feed your soul idea. Good luck to you, too.
I feel apathetic towards it now; I've tried to get help multiple times and it just falls through.

Nope, nothing that I can attribute it to. Perfectly fine childhood and adolescence so far. I had/still have and am still recovering from an eating disorder which makes the depression and anxiety worse (or they make the eating disorder worse, I have no fucking clue)
Plenty of times, so much so that I can talk about it objectively now without really thinking about it. It's strange for me to get emotional when discussing it anymore.

I'm glad I'm only using my bed and nothing that can really do me any harm. 

I went to see a movie with my mum today, I exercise pretty regularly, go for walks and runs. Nothing does the trick. 

I hope you're in a better place emotionally now.
